result.summary: The food delivery app page appears largely functional and well-designed. Found a few minor layout and content issues related to text truncation and heart icon inconsistency.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge of the screen, along with its card image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll carousel items are fully visible or add clearer visual affordance indicating more content can be scrolled into view.

issues.description: The favorite/heart icons on the two 'Popular right now' cards have inconsistent styling — one has a white circular background while the other has a dark/transparent circular background, making them look unequal.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon background styling across all cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' section (pizza with -20% badge) is missing its restaurant name, rating, and details, appearing incomplete compared to the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant metadata (name, rating, delivery info) loads and displays for all cards, or verify the content is not being cut off below the visible area.
